comments.text:
Guaranteed / income plans ka primary role inflation beat karna nahi hota.
Ye plans stability, predictability aur capital protection ke liye hote hain.

Inflation beat karne ke liye equity / ULIP / mutual funds use hote hain,
aur guaranteed plans unke saath portfolio balance karne ke liye.

Isliye sahi approach hai –
👉 protection + growth + stability ka combination,
na ki sirf ek product se sab expect karna.

Is type ke income plans ka ek practical use ye bhi hota hai ki
jo early guaranteed income milti hai,
use SIP / mutual funds me invest karke long-term growth create ki ja sakti hai.

Isse ek hi premium se:
👉 guaranteed income (stability)
👉 SIP ke through growth (inflation hedge)
👉 life insurance cover (protection)

milta hai — lekin SIP return market-linked hote hain, guaranteed nahi.
Isliye ye approach un logon ke liye kaam karti hai jo discipline ke saath reinvest karte hain.
comments.author: @AnilRajpurohitFFFS

comments.text: Interest less than 6%
comments.author: @sail29

comments.text:
ICICI Pru GIFT Select ko ‘interest product’ samajhna hi galat comparison hai.
Ye FD-type plan nahi, बल्कि ek guaranteed income + protection based insurance contract hai.

Insurance products में return sirf ek benefit hota है —
primary value guarantee, tax-benefit aur life cover hota है.

👉 Is plan me effective IRR har case me ~6% ke aas-paas hi hota hai,lekin yeh sirf ‘maturity IRR’ hota hai,
poora benefit picture nahi.

uske saath milta hai:
✔ पूरी maturity guarantee (market risk = zero)
✔ Guaranteed income schedule
✔ Tax-free payout (10(10D))
✔ insurance cover 
✔ No TDS, no market fluctuation
✔ Premium protection in case of death

Ye combination kisi simple interest product me milta hi nahi.
